objective: Verify the PR #264 FastAPI raw DR24 endpoint against the live HATS source for three OIDs and compare the API payload hashes with the independently verified probe artifact.
previous_knowledge_consumed: The raw DR24 HATS probe returned three OIDs and 417 epochs in workflow run 42061697065.
The probe artifact contains per-OID canonical payload SHA-256 values for the three test OIDs.
PR #264 adds GET /v1/dr24/objects/{objectid}/lightcurve and a source-native ObservationService path.
The DR24 backend must preserve HMJD, mag, magerr, clrcoeff, and catflags without normalization.
The API test must not use the frozen v0.2.0 model or ALeRCE fallback.

baseline.description: This is a live integration test on a branch stacked on PR #264. It does not change the default branch or merge the adapter.

correctness.before: PR #264 had deterministic adapter tests but no verified live API-to-HATS parity result.
correctness.after: A live TestClient request to the API route is compared against the three independently verified per-OID payload hashes, catalog epoch counts, partition metadata, and catflags distributions.

reproducibility.before: The raw probe artifact verified HATS acquisition outside the application API.
reproducibility.after: The API smoke test records code revision, workflow run, retrieval timestamps, per-OID payload hashes, and object-level counts in a compact artifact.

reliability.before: The API adapter had no live source-backed parity result.
reliability.after: Workflow run 42063653144 completed successfully. The API returned 417 epochs for three OIDs. All three canonical payload SHA-256 values exactly matched the independent HATS probe artifact. Per-OID catalog_nepochs and returned epoch counts matched.

scientific_validity.reason: Raw API parity does not validate physical-source identity, feature compatibility, classifier performance, calibration, OOD, or anomaly detection.

measurement.trade_off: Use three known OIDs and compare exact payload hashes. Do not expand the query or apply scientific transformations.

evidence: The test uses FastAPI TestClient and the real DR24LightcurveBackend.
The test compares per-OID canonical payload hashes with the independently verified probe artifact.
The test checks catalog_nepochs, returned epoch counts, filterid, fieldid, rcid, catflags counts, and source provenance.
The test is skipped in ordinary offline CI unless ZTF_DR24_LIVE_TEST=1 is set.
The branch-scoped workflow enables the live test and uploads only a compact JSON evidence artifact.

unresolved: The Workbench browser view in PR #267 remains unverified against the live API.
A 5–10 object end-to-end application smoke test with UI, QC, exports, and reproducibility bundle remains open.

findings: The raw-source probe can be used as a byte-level reference for the API adapter.
Matching per-OID payload hashes provides a stronger parity check than matching only epoch counts.
The live test must remain separate from ordinary offline CI and must not invoke inference.

open_blockers: Test the Workbench browser flow against the verified live API.
Test explicit missing-OID and source-failure behavior through the API.
Complete a 5–10 object end-to-end application smoke test with QC, visualization, exports, and a reproducibility bundle.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not merge PR #264 until live API parity and ordinary CI pass.
Do not merge PR #267 until browser interaction tests pass against the verified API.
Keep the raw DR24 path separate from the frozen v0.2.0 inference contract.
Do not claim Park MVP acceptance from this three-OID API smoke test.
